title: Package Model Lifecycle Workflow

construction_flows.constructor: inherits Package constructor exactly; adds extra fields defaulted to null/[]

steps: aliasOf is typed as CompletePackage (narrower than AliasPackage's BasePackage)

version_replacement.note: Only available on Package/CompletePackage; AliasPackage does not expose replaceVersion

steps: check: getDistUrl() !== null AND distUrl matches github/bitbucket/gitlab pattern (Preg::isMatch)
[YES] → setDistReference($reference) + setDistUrl(regex_replace SHA in distUrl with reference)
[NO distReference at all] → skip dist update
if indexed array (isset($requires[0])) → convertLinksToMap($requires, 'setRequires') — triggers deprecation

getUrls_logic: if urlType=dist and URL contains '%' → ComposerMirror::processUrl(url, name, version, ref, type, prettyVersion)

alias_delegation_pattern.description: AliasPackage and CompleteAliasPackage delegate almost all calls to aliasOf
alias_delegation_pattern.complete_alias_delegates: All CompletePackageInterface methods (scripts, license, keywords, authors, description, homepage, support, funding, abandoned, archiveName, archiveExcludes) → aliasOf

replaceSelfVersionDependencies_logic.purpose: Rewrite 'self.version' constraint links with the alias's actual version
replaceSelfVersionDependencies_logic.for_conflict_provide_replace: append new Link with Constraint('=', aliasVersion) alongside original
replaceSelfVersionDependencies_logic.for_require_devRequire: replace Link in-place; sets hasSelfVersionRequires=true if TYPE_REQUIRE
replaceSelfVersionDependencies_logic.prettyVersion_override: if prettyVersion === VersionParser::DEFAULT_BRANCH_ALIAS → use aliasOf.getPrettyVersion() instead

activity_workflow_summary: construct(name, version, prettyVersion) → parseStability → set dev flag
[optional] setRequires → setConflicts → setProvides → setReplaces → setDevRequires → setSuggests
[CompletePackage only] setLicense → setKeywords → setAuthors → setDescription → setHomepage
[CompletePackage only] setSupport → setFunding → setAbandoned → setScripts → setRepositories
[IF version update needed] replaceVersion(newVersion, newPrettyVersion) → parseStability again
[IF reference update needed] setSourceDistReferences(ref) → conditional dist URL patch
construct(aliasOf, version, prettyVersion) → copy name → parseStability
[IF mirrors needed] setDistMirrors/setSourceMirrors → delegates to aliasOf
[IF installation source] setInstallationSource → delegates to aliasOf
getDistUrls → getUrls → [for each mirror] ComposerMirror::processUrl → [preferred?] prepend : append
getSourceUrls → getUrls → [git mirror] processGitUrl | [hg mirror] processHgUrl
key_notes: Package is the core installable unit; CompletePackage adds human-facing metadata not used by solver
AliasPackage wraps an existing package under a different version string (used for branch-alias)
CompleteAliasPackage = AliasPackage of a CompletePackage; satisfies CompletePackageInterface via delegation
All setters in AliasPackage for dist/source data delegate to aliasOf — alias and original share dist state
replaceVersion recalculates stability from scratch (same logic as constructor)
setSourceDistReferences only patches distUrl for github/bitbucket/gitlab hosted packages (regex on SHA)
convertLinksToMap triggers deprecation warning — callers must pass name-keyed maps, not indexed arrays
